about: Alma is a city in Québec’s Saguenay–Lac-Saint-Jean region, on the Grande Décharge at the outlet of Lac Saint-Jean. It grew with pulp, paper, and aluminum industry along the river channels that drain the lake. The waterfront, islands, and winter outdoor culture remain central to daily life. About 30,000 people live in Alma.
